ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio (~1:10) featuring a dominant low-intensity black/dark-gray substrate with sparse, high-intensity white pixel clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: 90% dark contiguous pigmentation. High-contrast geometric white blobs concentrated at the lateral tips; scattered linear white markings and circular clusters (0.5% - 2% surface area) distributed across both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 50-60 degree V-shaped central notch with distinct depth reaching the axial junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably jagged profile with visible tissue loss and varying pixel-frequency peaks and valleys, particularly on the inner half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve originating from the median notch, sweeping upward to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes; numerous scattered circular white scars across the central lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of unaligned linear white pixel disruptions; prominent parallel rake marks (4-5 lines per set) visible on the lower-right and upper-left quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe adjacent to the median notch; heavy localized scarring and barnacle growth on lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical dark-gray midline seam originating from the base and extending toward the median notch.
